description.value:
“You can make almost anything run long past its expiration date. Yourself included.”

Patch & Repurpose. During a Soma Break, you can spend 10 minutes working on a single broken or low-charge item (a weapon, a tool, a power cell, a vehicle component, a piece of armour). Restore it to one more use, scene, or day of function. The GM rules how the item behaves at the end of that borrowed time — usually, it dies for real.

Jury-Rig (1/a Soma Break). When an ally within 30 feet rolls a 1 on a tool check, you may use your reaction to let them re-roll. Narratively, you guided their hands.
